title: Nice to meet you, I'm Bernardo Alencar. Designer and developer.
paragraphs: I work on creating interfaces and visual identities in an integrated way. I am currently a freelance Graphic Designer at Solitu, a Commercial Consultant at Loopis Jr., and a contributor to projects such as Verde Árido and Guardiões da Bandeira. My journey began in design, and as my interest in technology grew, I started studying Systems Analysis and Development.
I like understanding how things work and following the process from start to finish: taking a visual idea and turning it into a real, working application.
